# Medium use case fixture (~3K chars)

## Section 1: Capability area 1

### Personas
- Persona 1A: Operations lead responsible for workflow 1
- Persona 1B: Analyst who reviews metrics for area 1

### Requirements
- REQ-001-01: The system shall support end-to-end workflow 1 with audit logging
- REQ-001-02: Users must complete step 1 in fewer than 5 clicks on the happy path
- REQ-001-03: Export reports for area 1 in CSV and PDF formats

### Data entities (high level)
- Entity_1_Event, Entity_1_Summary, Entity_1_Assignment

### Acceptance criteria
Given a valid user for area 1, when they execute the primary journey, then outcomes match policy 1.
